summary: Chunghwa Telecom filed a Form 6-K on May 11, 2026, reporting the differences between its consolidated financial statements for Q1 2026 prepared under Taiwan-IFRSs versus IFRSs. The filing is a routine periodic financial update, not a special situation. It details net income, EPS, and balance sheet items under both standards, with differences mainly from income tax timing on unappropriated earnings and revenue recognition for fixed-line services and prepaid phone cards. No event related to acquisitions, divestitures, activism, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. The company is reporting as a foreign private issuer, so the 6-K equivalent is a regular current report under US rules. Watch for no event; this is purely financial disclosure.
